Tanya: hey team, first oncall day and i'm stuck. runbooks show a 403 when i click "incident-playbook" and pagerduty schedule doesn't list me. filed access form this morning. any quick fixes?
Marta: welcome! usually a group sync or SSO cookie issue. @Evan can you check group membership? also are you on corp-vpn?
Tanya: on corp-vpn. tried incognito and cleared cookies, still 403. PD shows me as 'pending' on the schedule.
Evan: checking sync... looks like tanya@redwood.ai missed the "eng-oncall-rotations" group during last night's sync. pushing a manual sync now.
infra-bot: Group sync started for LDAP -> SSO (job 8792)
Evan: sync complete, added tanya to group. Marta, can you approve the PagerDuty invite?
Marta: approved in PD. @Tanya try runbook link again and refresh PD.
oncall-bot: PagerDuty  Tanya added to schedule "eng-oncall" pending activation at 2026-04-01 08:00 UTC.
Tanya: runbook loads now, thanks! PD schedule still pending but i see the future shifts listed. one more thing: where do i find the contact matrix for DB and infra? the runbook contact section references an old phone.
Marta: good catch, contacts were updated last week but the night runbook cached an old copy. use the team contacts page https://internal.redwood.ai/contacts and search "DB Team". i'll update the runbook to point there. also let's schedule a 20m sim today at 3pm PT so you can shadow a mock pager.
Tanya: 3pm PT works. appreciate the quick help everyone :thumbsup:
Evan: i'll join the sim and walk through PD ack/resolve flow and show the quota dashboards.
Tanya: thanks! acknowledged the PD notification. excited to shadow. :smile:
